BenchSample.description:
One primary-level repeat retained for paired bootstrap confidence.

The observation's ``metrics`` remain the robust summary shown to operators.
These samples are the raw comparable repeats used by finalization; they are
never merged across prompt loads.
BenchSample.title: BenchSample

BenchmarkObservation.description:
Immutable normalized evidence for one candidate/context/attempt.

``observation_id`` is deterministic over candidate, attempt, evidence
lane and context. The controller uses it as the idempotency key for
duplicate worker completions.
BenchmarkObservation.title: BenchmarkObservation

CandidateSpec.description:
A concrete, reproducible parameter vector for one trial and context.

``candidate_id`` is deterministic over the study, engine hash, model digest,
worker, context, workload digest and parameters. Scoping the identity to a
study keeps repeated experiments with the same baseline from colliding in
the controller's global candidate table, while ``semantic_key`` still
supports duplicate detection inside one study.
CandidateSpec.title: CandidateSpec

CapabilityDescriptor.description:
One observed, typed engine parameter.

Flags absent from the installed binary must not be represented as
supported. ``provenance`` records how support was established.
CapabilityDescriptor.title: CapabilityDescriptor

ExperimentSpec.description:
Immutable definition of one optimization study.

It binds explicit engine/model identities, the worker, objective, context
matrix, search policy, workload protocol and constraints. It never contains
mutable process handles or local-only credentials.
ExperimentSpec.title: ExperimentSpec

ImpactAssessment.description: Deterministic applicability result for one worker/model context.
ImpactAssessment.title: ImpactAssessment

ReleaseAsset.description: Metadata for one official release asset. It is never downloaded here.
ReleaseAsset.title: ReleaseAsset

ReleaseMetadata.description:
Operator-supplied release facts.

A pinned local checkout, release feed or official manifest may populate this
model. ``capability_manifest`` is optional and must describe the candidate
build when present; it is not treated as an installed observation.
ReleaseMetadata.title: ReleaseMetadata
